nodes.title: Derive one quote from the dates and the guests
nodes.why: The nightly line, the stay, the total and the button all read one value, so a guest change or a new date can never leave one of them stale.
nodes.alternative: Keep the total in state and update it in each change handler.
nodes.tradeoff: A stored total has to be recomputed in every handler that can change it; a derived quote is recomputed by React when its inputs change.

nodes.title: Count nights in UTC days
nodes.why: Parsing a date input as local time can lose or gain an hour on a clock change, and an hour off turns three nights into 2.96. UTC days are whole numbers.
nodes.alternative: Subtract two `new Date(value)` objects and divide by a day.
nodes.tradeoff: Local dates read naturally but break around daylight saving; UTC needs one helper.

nodes.title: Price extra guests per night
nodes.why: The listing price covers two guests; each guest after that adds a fee for every night, so the fee belongs in the nightly price, not in a one-off line.
nodes.alternative: Add the guest fee once to the total.
nodes.tradeoff: A one-off fee undercharges long stays and makes the nightly line wrong.

nodes.title: Check booked dates as half-open ranges
nodes.why: A stay and a booking overlap when the stay starts before the booking ends and ends after it starts. Treating both as half-open lets a guest check out on the morning the next one checks in.
nodes.alternative: List every booked night and look for each night of the stay.
nodes.tradeoff: A night list works for short stays but grows with the calendar; two comparisons per range do not.

nodes.title: Cap guests at the listing maximum
nodes.why: Adults and children share one cap, so both plus buttons read the same sum and disable together when the cabin is full.
nodes.alternative: Validate the guest count when the guest clicks Book now.
nodes.tradeoff: A late error makes the guest undo their choices; disabled buttons never let them make an impossible one.

nodes.title: Gate Book now on the quote
nodes.why: The button is enabled exactly when there is a priced stay to book, and the message next to it says why when there is not.
nodes.alternative: Enable the button and show errors after a click.
nodes.tradeoff: An enabled button that fails teaches the guest to distrust it; a disabled one with a reason does not.

nodes.title: Move focus into the dialog and back
nodes.why: A keyboard or screen reader user must land in the dialog when it opens and back on Book now when it closes, or the confirmation is invisible to them.
nodes.alternative: Render the summary inline under the button.
nodes.tradeoff: Inline text is simpler but gives no moment to confirm; a dialog needs focus handling and Escape.
